_comment: vulnagent -> DefectDojo. Copy to /etc/vulnagent/defectdojo.json (mode 0600: it holds the API token). Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_url: Base URL of your DefectDojo server, without /api/v2
_api_token: DefectDojo -> your user (top right) -> API v2 Key. Can also be given as env DD_API_TOKEN.
_product_type: Created automatically if it does not exist. Use e.g. one per site or department.
_product_name: One product per machine. {host} = FQDN, {short} = short hostname
_verify_tls: Set ca_file to your internal CA for a self-signed certificate rather than turning verification off
